mechanism: Sirolimus may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of levodopa substrates and carbidopa is a peripheral decarboxylase inhibitor that could theoretically affect sirolimus metabolism; additive CNS effects possible.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa adverse effects (dyskinesias, hallucinations, hypotension) and sirolimus toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of sirolimus levels; assess clinical response and adjust doses if needed.
